task.description: Design fix: each test that creates a fixture tenant via h.conn.exec must instead use a fresh pool connection (commit + visible to other connections). Pattern already established in TC-SVC-04-06/08 (process_definitions). For svc04-02 (register tenant-scoped), svc04-05 (update), svc04-09 (list), svc04-10 (admin list) — convert tenant inserts to use pool.acquire().
acceptance_criteria: All 6 affected tests mapped to fix pattern

result.summary: Fix design: add insertFixtureTenantViaPool helper + schema-registration in provision step
